changes: Remove ad-rule archive maintenance from the blocking storage-page load path. Share/coalesce disk scans, prepare path classifiers once, reuse installed-bundle size and keep existing values visible while refreshing.
Refresh on return from modern navigation and iOS 16 management sheets. Invalidate stale in-flight scans after cleanup so deleted files cannot reappear in cached totals.
Separate cache-only website files from saved IndexedDB/local storage and cookies; use matching cleanup scope and keep total category accounting without duplicate bytes.
Continue clearing other eligible files and categories when a file is active, protected, missing or unavailable; report retained categories and individual failures.
Anchor per-row deletion confirmation to its source button. Left-aligned text controls open below the button instead of forcing a narrow popover to its left.
Remove the misleading full-Documents Files shortcut from Other app data. Its entries show only actual classified files; Downloads retains its own file-management route.
Show website origin lists before optional size measurement completes, and refresh those lists after child management returns.

unit.scope: Disk accounting, website-cache/persistent-data separation, retained active files with eligible files removed, download ownership, live rule lists, symlink safety, coalesced and invalidated scans, deleted-download refresh, real WebKit IndexedDB behavior.

performance.scope: Isolated simulator disk fixture; physical-device performance not inferred.

qa_fixtures: Only com.dkluge.Soulo.Acceptance simulator containers: 1 MiB Other caches, 1 MiB wallpaper preview, 2 MiB download. No user container data is cleared.
notes: Early UI download setup used an incorrect navigation/Done assumption and did not scroll/filter offscreen files; failed driver runs are not counted as passing. Final storage acceptance uses deterministic seeded QA files, with real file deletion and before/after totals.
No commit, push, deployment or TestFlight upload performed. No physical iPhone operated.

Final navigation tests use the minimum-iOS-16 QA binary on iOS 26.2 and iPadOS 26.2 as well. These exercise the shipping minimum deployment target while leaving the separate Release build undisturbed.

visual_review.scope: The left-aligned clear button now presents a normal-width popover below its anchor. Screenshot inspected; buttons and text visible, no narrow strip.
